content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer, so those avenues are closed. An appeal was already filed and failed. With no records-based or procedural path to overturn a hard auth requirement that cannot be retroactively satisfied, this is a provider-responsibility write-off; it cannot be billed to the patient since the auth failure is not the patient's fault.","action":"write_off"}
